items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: We joined that band. We joined Senegal. Edwin Mayer. Eddie Bull. Wilbert Smith. Charles Connors. And myself. We joined that band. To play behind the Famous Flames. With the lead singer was James Brown.

ctx.x: Yeah. Every night in the week. I need you good loving every night in the week. A Monday night is something else. A Tuesday night is something. I recorded that with him. Damn, I can't think of the guy that recorded with him. But it was Edwin Mayer. He's playing guitar. And I can't remember who played what else. It was a young old Nat Parallel that played tennis sax. Charles Connors played drums. That was our young band. So forth.
Well, y'all were obviously on the road.
